q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: WITH frequents_count AS (SELECT bar, COUNT(DISTINCT drinker) AS total_drinkers FROM frequents GROUP BY bar), average_price AS (SELECT bar, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM serves GROUP BY bar), top_drinker AS (SELECT bar, drinker, times_a_week, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bar ORDER BY times_a_week DESC) AS rn FROM frequents) SELECT b.name AS bar_name, fc.total_drinkers, ap.avg_price, td.drinker AS top_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents_count AS fc ON b.name = fc.bar LEFT JOIN average_price AS ap ON b.name = ap.bar LEFT JOIN top_drinker AS td ON b.name = td.bar AND td.rn = 1 ORDER BY fc.total_drinkers DESC
